Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.

Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Eternal Frost
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG and create 1 Ice Prism.

info.name: Clarity of Mind
info.description:
Heavy Attack: Detonate
When holding Basic Attack, a cursor moves back and forth on the Forte Gauge. Release Basic Attack when the cursor is in the Frostbite area to perform Heavy Attack Detonate, dealing Glacio DMG.
Ice Burst
Sanhua's Heavy Attack Detonate detonates all Ice Thorns, Ice Prisms, and Glaciers within her attack range, dealing Glacio DMG.
Frostbite Area
The Frostbite area expands with every 1 stack of Clarity, up to 2 stacks.
Sanhua gains Clarity through Basic Attack 5, Intro Skill, Resonance Skill, and Resonance Liberation.
All Clarity is removed upon casting Heavy Attack: Detonate.

info.name: Glacial Gaze
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG and create 1 Glacier.

info.name: Freezing Thorns
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG and create 1 Ice Thorn.

info.name: Destined Promise
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack
Continuously consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Emergency Plan
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG and heal all nearby party members.

info.name: Cycle of Life
info.description:
You'tan
You'tan shares all of Baizhi's stats. You'tan goes back to Baizhi when Baizhi dodges.
Concentration
When casting Heavy Attack or Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, Baizhi consumes all Concentration and continuously heals nearby party members based on the number of Concentration consumed.
When Baizhi consumes Concentration to cast Heavy Attack, she also regenerates Concerto Energy and Resonance Energy.
When Baizhi consumes Concentration to cast Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, she also regenerates Concerto Energy.
Forte Gauge: Concentration
Baizhi can hold up to 4 Concentration.
Baizhi gains Concentration through Basic Attack.

info.name: Momentary Union
info.description:
Heal all nearby party members, generating 4 stacks of Remnant Entities.
Remnant Entities
Remnant Entities follow the active team members. Remnant Entities are automatically consumed to attack targets, dealing Glacio DMG on hit while healing all nearby party members.

info.name: Overflowing Frost
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG and heal all nearby party members.

info.name: Majestic Fists
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack: Feral Roars
After Resonance Skill Furious Punches is cast, Basic Attack 5 becomes Feral Roars, dealing Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Ancient Arts
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG.
Furious Punches
When Basic Attacks 3, 4, or 5 or Basic Attack Feral Roars hits the target, Resonance Skill is replaced with Furious Punches.
Use Basic Attack to cast Basic Attack 3 shortly after casting Resonance Skill Furious Punches following Basic Attack Feral Roars.
Lingyang's Resonance Skill does not reset his Basic Attack cycle.

info.name: Unification of Spirits
info.description:
Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge
When Lion's Spirit is full, use Heavy Attack to perform Glorious Plunge, dealing Glacio DMG.
Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike
When Lion's Spirit is not full, use Basic Attack shortly after Heavy Attack to perform Tail Strike, dealing Glacio DMG.
Striding Lion
After casting Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge, enter the Striding Lion state.
After casting Intro Skill Lion Awakens or Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, if Lion's Spirit is full, use Basic Attack to enter the Striding Lion state.
In the Striding Lion state:
- Attacks can be performed in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge to get back in the air.
- Lion's Spirit is continuously consumed, and when it runs out, the Striding Lion state ends.
- The consumption rate of Lion's Spirit in the Lion's Vigor state is reduced.
- Lingyang's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Feral Gyrate, dealing Glacio DMG.
- Lingyang's Resonance Skill is replaced with Mountain Roamer, dealing Glacio DMG.
- When Lion's Spirit is less than 10, use Basic Attack to perform Basic Attack Stormy Kicks, dealing Glacio DMG. After performing Basic Attack Stormy Kicks, the Mid-air Attack Tail Strike becomes available.
- Consuming Lion's Spirit restores Concerto Energy.
Lion's Spirit
Lingyang can hold up to 100 Lion's Spirit.
Lingyang gains Lion's Spirit through Resonance Skill, Intro Skill, and Resonance Liberation.

info.name: Strive: Lion's Vigor
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG and gain Lion's Vigor.
Lion's Vigor
Lingyang gains 50% Glacio DMG Bonus.

info.name: Lion Awakens
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Dimming Brush
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Manifestation
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG. If Zhezhi has at least 60 Afflatus, consume 60 Afflatus to summon 2 Phantasmic Imprints.

info.name: Ink and Wash
info.description:
Phantasmic Imprint
Zhezhi consumes Afflatus to summon Phantasmic Imprints when casting Resonance Skill Manifestation or Heavy Attack Conjuration.
Heavy Attack - Conjuration
The 5 moves below consume STA to perform Conjuration, dealing Glacio DMG.
- Holding Basic Attack after Basic Attack 3.
- Using Basic Attack after casting Resonance Skill Manifestation.
- Holding Basic Attack after casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith.
- Holding Basic Attack while in mid-air.
- Holding Basic Attack after a successful Dodge.
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, 30 Afflatus is consumed to summon a Phantasmic Imprint - Middle.
Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius
When any Phantasmic Imprint is on the field, Zhezhi's Resonance Skill becomes Stroke of Genius. When it is cast, Zhezhi deals Glacio DMG and gains 1 stack of Painter's Delight.
Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith
When any Phantasmic Imprint is on the field and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, Stroke of Genius becomes Creation's Zenith. When cast, Zhezhi deals greater Glacio DMG, and her Basic Attack DMG Bonus is increased.
Afflatus
Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Zhezhi gains Afflatus through Normal Attack and Intro Skill.

info.name: Living Canvas
info.description:
Summon Inklit Spirits for assistance.
Inklit Spirit
When the Resonator on the field deals damage, an Inklit Spirit is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

info.name: Radiant Ruin
info.description: Deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Frosty Punches
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack
- When Frost is full, hold Basic Attack to cast Frostfall.
Youhu gains Frost in the following ways:
- When Frost is not full, hold Basic Attack to enter the Fortune Rolling state and restore Frost over time.
- When Basic Attacks hit a target.
Heavy Attack: Frostfall
Deal Glacio DMG and perform Lucky Draw once.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Glacio DMG and perform Lucky Draw once.

info.name: Scroll Divination
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG, healing all party members nearby, and perform Lucky Draw once.
Lucky Draw
Youhu obtains a random Antique after the Lucky Draw. With an Antique, her next Basic Attack will activate the corresponding Antique Appraisal.
Antique Appraisal
- Chime: Deal Glacio DMG. Chime greatly reduces the enemy's Vibration Strength.
- Ruyi: Deal Glacio DMG. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.
- Ding: Deal Glacio DMG Ding effectively breaks the enemy's stance.
- Mask: Deal Glacio DMG. Mask pulls enemies along its path.

info.name: Poetic Essence
info.description:
At four Auspices, hold Basic Attack to cast Poetic Essence, dealing Glacio DMG while healing all nearby party members.
Youhu can hold up to 4 Auspices.
Poetic Essence
Deal Glacio DMG and also gain one of the following effects based on Auspice combinations:
- Free Verse: 4 unique Auspices additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of enemies.
- Antithesis: 1 pair of Auspices increase DMG by 70%.
- Double Pun: 2 pairs of Auspices additionally heal all nearby party members.
- Triplet: 3 identical Auspices increase DMG by 175%.
- Perfect Rhyme: 4 identical Auspices activate the effects of Free Verse, Double Pun, and Triplet all at once.
Casting Poetic Essence removes all Auspices.
Auspice
Youhu gains Auspice through Antique Appraisal.

info.name: Fortune's Favor
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG.
During the blast, buttons will appear. Choose a button within the specified time to obtain the corresponding Antique.

info.name: Scroll of Wonders
info.description: Perform Lucky Draw once.

info.name: Silent Execution
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Necessary Measures
With Moldable Crystals, Carlotta's Basic Attack is replaced with Necessary Measures, dealing Glacio DMG.
Each strike of Necessary Measures consumes 1 Moldable Crystal.
Heavy Attack
Perform a charged attack that deals Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack - Containment Tactics
When Carlotta's Substance is full, her Heavy Attack will be replaced with Containment Tactics: consume all Substance to deal Glacio DMG and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill.
Mid-air Attack
Perform a Plunging Attack that deals Glacio DMG. Using Basic Attack shortly after the landing will cast Customary Greetings.
Mid-air Attack - Customary Greetings
Deal Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Glacio DMG. This consumes 1 Moldable Crystal.

info.name: Art of Violence
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG and inflict Dispersion on the target. Press Resonance Skill again shortly after to cast Chromatic Splendor.
Dispersion
Targets with Dispersion are immobilized.
Chromatic Splendor
Consume all Moldable Crystals and deal Glacio DMG.
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown after a while if Chromatic Splendor is not cast or Carlotta is switched off the field.

info.name: Lethal Repertoire
info.description:
Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion
Carlotta activates Tinted Crystal every 22s.
When Substance is full and Tinted Crystal is activated, hold Normal Attack to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion, after which Tinted Crystal enters cooldown.
Deal Glacio DMG and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill Art of Violence by 6s.
Final Bow
When Substance is full, enter the Final Bow state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Era of New Wave , Resonance Liberation Death Knell, and Resonance Liberation Fatal Finale by 80%. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during Twilight Tango or when Twilight Tango ends.
Substance
Carlotta can hold up to 120 points of Substance.
Cannot obtain Substance when in Twilight Tango.
Substance can be obtained in the following ways: Intro Skill Wintertime Aria, consuming Moldable Crystals via Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor, Basic Attack Necessary Measures, and Dodge Counter.
Moldable Crystal
Carlotta can hold up to 6 Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystals while in Twilight Tango.
Moldable Crystal can be obtained in the following ways: Intro Skill, Basic Attack Stage 2, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack Customary Greetings, Resonance Skill Art of Violence, and a successful Dodge.

info.name: Era of New Wave
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG and inflict Deconstruction, then activate Twilight Tango.
Can be cast in mid-air.
Deconstruction
Dealing DMG to targets inflicted with Deconstruction ignores 18% of their DEF.
Twilight Tango
While in Twilight Tango, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Death Knell.
Each Death Knell grants 1 Meta Vector.
With 4 Meta Vectors, press Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Fatal Finale.
- All Substance is removed when activating and ending Twilight Tango. Cannot cast Basic Attack Necessary Measures, Heavy Attack Containment Tactics, and Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion while in Twilight Tango.
Death Knell
Deal Glacio DMG.
- Carlotta moves in the direction of the movement input with each shot of Death Knell.
Fatal Finale
Deal Glacio DMG to an area, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- Twilight Tango ends after casting Fatal Finale.

info.name: Wintertime Aria
info.description: Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

info.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
info.description:
Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self
When Dedication is full, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and Dedication to deal Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, hold Normal Attack to enter Hold Breath. Release Normal Attack to deal Glacio DMG and block the incoming attack.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self
When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self is replaced with Heavy Attack -Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self.
Consume STA and Whiteout Bitterfrost to deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Frostblight
info.description:
Resonance Skill - Present Self
Deal Glacio DMG.
While in Foreclaimed Self, Resonance Skill - Present Self is replaced by Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall:
Frostblight: Jade Cleave
Can be cast on the ground. Deal Glacio DMG.
Frostblight: Petalfall
Can be cast in mid-air. Deal Glacio DMG.

info.name: Everfrost Dominion
info.description:
Glacio Bite
While Hiyuki is in the team, Glacio Chafe inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is replaced by Glacio Bite.
When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits the target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of Glacio Bite, remove 10 stacks and trigger Frostbind once.
Present Self
Hiyuki starts in Present Self.
Foreclaimed Self
Hiyuki enters Foreclaimed Self after casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. While in Foreclaimed Self, new skill forms are unlocked.
Iai Stance
Hold Resonance Skill or press Dodge while casting the certain attacks of Foreclaimed Self to enter Iai Stance at the cost of STA.
Basic Attack - Iai
While in Iai Stance, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Iai, dealing Glacio DMG and blocking incoming attacks. If Hiyuki has Frostharden Iai, consume 1 stack of it to enhance this attack and gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost. Press Glacio DMG to continuously cast it.
Dedication
A special resource used while in Present Self. Built up through certain attacks and consumed when casting Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
Frostheart
A special resource used while in Foreclaimed Self. Built up through certain attacks and consumed when casting Basic Attack - Iai.
Frostharden Iai
Gained through Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. Enhances Basic Attack - Iai.
Whiteout Bitterfrost
Gained when Frostharden Iai is consumed through Basic Attack - Iai. When full, Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self becomes available.
Snowforged Blade
Gained upon casting Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self. Enhances Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation.

info.name: Foreclaiming
info.description:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after casting Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
Deal Glacio DMG. Upon casting, enter Foreclaimed Self.
Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation
Hold Resonance Liberation to enter a charging state by continuously consuming Snowforged Blade. Release Resonance Liberation to deal Glacio DMG. The more Snowforged Blade consumed while charging the attack, the higher the DMG dealt.
After casting, exit Foreclaimed Self.

info.name: Frostedge
info.description:
Deal Glacio DMG.
If Hiyuki is in Present Self, casting this skill restores Dedication.

info.name: Snapshot
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Glacio DMG
Casting Basic Attack Stage 3 deploys a ring.
Landing the cursor within the highlight area allows Lucilla to deal increased Glacio DMG and restore additional Forte Gauge.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

info.name: Phantom Frame
info.description:
Hold Resonance Skill to deploy a ring, dealing Glacio DMG.
Landing the cursor within the highlight area allows Lucilla to cast Enhanced Resonance Skill, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Forte Gauge.
While casting Enhanced Resonance Skill, Lucilla additionally restores Concerto Energy. While in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Lucilla can inflict Glacio Chafe on targets.

info.name: Memory Palace
info.description:
Forte Gauge
Casting Intro Skill restores Forte Gauge.
Casting Resonance Skill and Basic Attack Stage 3 restores Forte Gauge. Landing the cursor within the highlight area increases the restoration amount.
For every certain amount of Forte Gauge restored, generate 1 Photo.
Resonance Mode Enhancements
While casting Resonance Liberation, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Lucilla gains certain stacks of Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement. When an active Resonator other than Lucilla inflicts Glacio Chafe onto the target, Lucilla consumes Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe: Enhancement to inflict additional Glacio Chafe on the target.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, Lucilla gains certain stacks of Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement. Each stack of Resonance Mode - Echo: Enhancement increases the Crit. DMG of Echo Skill for the active Resonator in the team.
Photo Attack
When casting Basic Attack - Enhanced State Stage 3, Lucilla consumes Photos to deal Glacio DMG:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, inflict Glacio Chafe onto the target hit.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, each cast of this skill is considered as casting a different skill.

info.name: Clear As Day
info.description:
Resonance Liberation is unlocked with 3 Photos.
Deal Glacio DMG and enter Enhanced State.
While in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, Lucilla gains Basic Attack DMG Bonus/Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
Basic Attack - Enhanced State
Deal Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Enhanced State Stage 3 performs consecutive attacks. Basic Attack - Enhanced State: Finisher is automatically cast at the end of it, which ends Enhanced State.
Mid-air Attack - Enhanced State
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter - Enhanced State
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

info.name: Clip It
info.description: Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and inficting Glacio Chafe.

info.name: Unraveled Spring
info.description:
Basic Attack - Water Fan Form
Deal Glacio DMG.
Mid-air Attack - Water Fan Form
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.
Dodge Counter - Water Fan Form
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

info.name: Vernal Screen
info.description:
Resonance Skill - Water Fan Form
Available during the Water Fan Form. Suisui thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG.
Awakening Spring
When in the Water Fan Form and at full Water Fan Form Energy, the skill becomes available, sending Suisui into the Water Sleeves Form and dealing Glacio DMG.
Enrichment
Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby Resonators in the team Enrichment: Enrichment is consumed upon casting Intro Skill and restores the Resonator's HP.
Resonance Skill - Water Sleeves Form
Available during the Water Sleeves Form. Suisui thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG.

info.name: Lambent Gold
info.description:
Water Fan Form
Suisui is in the Water Fan Form by default. When in the Water Fan Form, Suisui can obtain Water Fan Form Energy through certain skills.
Water Sleeves Form
When in the Water Sleeves Form, Suisui unlocks new moves, and her certain skills can restore Water Sleeves Form Energy.
When in the Water Sleeves Form, Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
Dodge - Parting Mist
While performing attacks on the ground, press Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
Basic Attack - Water Sleeves Form
When in the Water Sleeves Form, Basic Attack - Water Fan Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Water Sleeves Form.
Deal Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack - Water Sleeves Form
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
Illuminating Dew
When in the Water Sleeves Form, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Water Sleeves Form to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.
Swallow's Cut
When in the Water Sleeves Form, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Water Sleeves Form.
- Press Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.
Water Fan Form Energy
When in the Water Fan Form, Suisui restores Water Fan Form Energy in the following ways:
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack - Water Fan Form and Dodge Counter - Water Fan Form;
- Casting Resonance Skill - Water Fan Form when Suisui is the active Resonator;
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist.
Water Sleeves Form Energy
When in the Water Sleeves Form,  Suisui restores Water Sleeves Form Energy in the following ways:
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack - Water Sleeves Form and Heavy Attack - Water Sleeves Form;
- Casting Resonance Skill - Water Sleeves Form when Suisui is the active Resonator;
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist.

info.name: Song of Thoroughfare
info.description:
Casting this skill deploys Ceaseless Landscape.
When Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent upon casting Outro Skill.
All nearby Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain bonus effects after inflicting or consuming certain Negative Statuses, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG.

info.name: Tinkling Jade
info.description: Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG. Suisui enters the Water Sleeves Form upon casting this skill.

info.name: POW POW
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Fusion DMG.
Heavy Attack
Enter the aiming state to deal Fusion DMG.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Fusion DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Whizzing Fight Spirit
info.description:
Unleash a flurry of shots, dealing Fusion DMG.
Whizzing Fight Spirit has 2 initial charges.

info.name: Heroic Bullets
info.description:
Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!
Hold Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit to enter DAKA DAKA!. In this state:
-Chixia continuously fires Thermobaric Bullets to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
-Use Basic Attack to cast Basic Attack 4, dealing Fusion DMG and exiting the DAKA DAKA! state.
-If 30 Thermobaric Bullets have been fired when Basic Attack is used, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill Boom Boom and exit the DAKA DAKA! state.
-Chixia exits the DAKA DAKA! state when all Thermobaric Bullets are fired.
Resonance Skill: Boom Boom
Deal Fusion DMG.
Thermobaric Bullets
Chixia can hold up to 60 Thermobaric Bullets.
Inherent Skill Scorching Magazine increases Max Thermobaric Bullets by 10.
Chixia gains Thermobaric Bullets through Normal Attack, Intro Skill, and Resonance Skill.

info.name: Blazing Flames
info.description: Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Grand Entrance
info.description: Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Wooly Attack
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Fusion DMG.
Basic Attack: Wooly Strike
After Basic Attack 4, use Basic Attack to deal Fusion DMG.
Heavy Attack
Consume STA to deal Fusion DMG.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Fusion DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Flaming Woolies
info.description:
Flaming Woolies
Deal Fusion DMG.
Energetic Welcome
After casting Flaming Woolies, use Resonance Skill to perform Energetic Welcome, dealing Fusion DMG.

info.name: Black & White Woolies
info.description:
Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy
When Encore's Mayhem is full, after casting a Heavy Attack, Encore will consume all Mayhem to enter the Mayhem state.
After the Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast Cloudy Frenzy, dealing Fusion DMG.
Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture
During Cosmos Rave, when casting Heavy Attack, if Mayhem is full, Encore will consume all Mayhem to enter the Cosmos' Mayhem state.
After the Cosmos' Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast Cosmos Rupture, dealing Fusion DMG.
Mayhem
Encore can hold up to 100 Mayhem.
Encore gains Mayhem through Normal Attack, Resonance Skill, Intro Skill, and Resonance Liberation.

info.name: Cosmos Rave
info.description:
Enter the Cosmos Rave state. In this state:
- Basic Attack becomes Cosmos: Frolicking, dealing Fusion DMG.
- Heavy Attack becomes Cosmos: Heavy Attack, consuming STA to deal Fusion DMG.
- Flaming Woolies becomes Cosmos: Rampage, dealing Fusion DMG.
- Dodge Counter becomes Cosmos: Dodge Counter, dealing Fusion DMG.

info.name: Woolies Helpers
info.description: Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Impromptu Show
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Fusion DMG.
Heavy Attack
Deal Fusion DMG.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Fusion DMG.
Dodge Counter
Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Passionate Variation
info.description: Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Fury Fugue
info.description:
Resonance Skill: Fury Fugue
When Mortefi's Annoyance reaches 100, his Resonance Skill becomes Fury Fugue.
Casting Fury Fugue consumes all Annoyance to deal Fusion DMG.
Annoyance
Mortefi can hold up to 100 Annoyance.
Mortefi gains Annoyance through Normal Attack, Intro Skill, and Resonance Skill.

info.name: Violent Finale
info.description:
Deal Fusion DMG, and apply Burning Rhapsody to all Resonators on the team.
Burning Rhapsody
When the active Resonator's Basic Attack or Heavy Attack hits the target, Mortefi launches Marcato as the Coordinated Attack.
Marcato
Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Dissonance
info.description: Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Blazing Enlightment
info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Fusion DMG.
After Ground Basic Attack 4, enter True Sight.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to deal Fusion DMG.
After Mid-air Attack 4, enter True Sight.
Heavy Attack
Consume STA to perform an upward strike, dealing Fusion DMG. Use Basic Attack within a certain time to perform Mid-Air Attack 3.
Mid-air Heavy Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG. Use Basic Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack 3.
Dodge Counter
Deal Fusion DMG.

info.name: Tripartite Flames
info.description:
True Sight: Capture
After using her Resonance Skill to attack an enemy, Changli enters True Sight, dealing Fusion DMG.
True Sight: Capture has 2 initial charges. Changli can hold up to 2 charges. 1 charge is replenished every 12s. It can be cast in mid-air.
Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest
When in True Sight, if Changli uses Ground Basic Attack, she dashes towards the enemy, dealing Fusion DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG), after which True Sight ends.
Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge
When in True Sight, if Changli jumps or uses Basic Attack in mid-air, she dashes towards the enemy, dealing Fusion DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG), after which True Sight ends.

info.name: Flaming Sacrifice
info.description:
Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice
When casting Heavy Attack, if Changli has 4 stacks of Enflamement, she consumes them all to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG. This damage is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While casting Flaming Sacrifice, Changli takes 40% less DMG.
Enflamement
Changli can hold up to 4 stacks of Enflamement.
Changli gains Enflamement through Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest, Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge, and Resonance Liberation Radiance of Fealty.

info.name: Radiance of Fealty
info.description:
Deal Fusion DMG, gain 4 stacks of Enflamement, and enter Fiery Feather.
Can be cast in mid-air.
Fiery Feather

Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms deals Spectro DMG on hit.
Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms

Rebound
When in Red Light Mode, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to backflip and attack the target before switching to Yellow Light Mode.
Yellow Light Mode
Perform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.
Red Light Mode
Perform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.

info.description:
Energized Pounce
When Yellow Light Spark is full, Resonance Skill becomes Energized Pounce which deals Electro DMG, and Lumi enters Red Spotlight Mode (the evolved version of Red Light Mode).
Energized Rebound
When Red Light Spark is full, Resonance Skill becomes Energized Rebound which deals Electro DMG, and Lumi enters Yellow Spotlight Mode (the evolved version of Yellow Light Mode).
Laser
Casting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks gained in the current mode.
Laser can be cast when the amount of Sparks consumed is greater than or equal to 25, dealing Electro DMG. Consuming more Sparks generates more Laser beams.
Yellow Light Spark

Lumi gains Yellow Light Spark when casting Intro Skill.

info.description:
Basic Attack
Deal Spectro DMG. Each hit generates 1 Collapsed Core.
Heavy Attack
Continuously consume STA to enter Unbound Form. In this form, Shorekeeper will:
- Generate a segment of Deductive Data every second;
- Automatically collect nearby plant collectibles.
- Using up all STA or actions such as casting Basic Attack will end Unbound Form and deal Spectro DMG to the target. Each accumulated segment of Deductive Data will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a Collapsed Core.
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, generating 1 Collapsed Core on hit. Quickly follow up with Basic Attack to perform Basic Attack 2.
Dodge Counter
Deal Spectro DMG.

info.name: Chaos Theory
info.description:
Heal all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. Follow up with Basic Attack to perform Basic Attack 2.
Can be cast in mid-air.

info.name: Astral Chord
info.description:
Flare Star Butterfly
Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a Collapsed Core, which transforms into a Flare Star Butterfly after 6s. Flare Star Butterflies automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. If there are 5 on-field Collapsed Cores, Shorekeeper's next Basic Attack will instantly convert a Collapsed Core into a Flare Star Butterfly.
Illation
When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Heavy Attack will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies.
Transmutation
When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Mid-air Attack will consume all segments to deal Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies. Quickly follow up with Basic Attack to perform Basic Attack 2.
Empirical Data
Shorekeeper can hold up to 5 segments of Empirical Data.
Shorekeeper gains Empirical Data through Normal Attack.

info.name: End Loop
info.description:
Outer Stellarealm
Generate the Outer Stellarealm to continuously heal all party members within its effective range.
Inner Stellarealm
When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Outer Stellarealm, it evolves into the Inner Stellarealm. Crit. Rate is increased for all party members within range of the Inner Stellarealm.
Inner Stellarealm has all the effects of the Outer Stellarealm.
Supernal Stellarealm
When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Inner Stellarealm, it evolves into the Supernal Stellarealm. Crit. DMG is increased for all party members within range of the Supernal Stellarealm.
Supernal Stellarealm has all the effects of the Outer Stellarealm and Inner Stellarealm.

info.name: Proof of Existence
info.description:
Enlightenment
Heal all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. This damage is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Discernment
While Supernal Stellarealm is active, Shorekeeper's Intro Skill Enlightenment becomes Intro Skill Discernment. Casting Discernment ends the existing Stellarealm, restores HP for all nearby party members, and deals Spectro DMG. This attack is guaranteed to be Critical, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG. Intro Skill Discernment can only be triggered once each time a Supernal Stellarealm is generated.

info.description:
Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate and dealing Spectro DMG. Using Resonance Skill again shortly after the summoning teleports Phoebe to the Ring of Mirrors' location, dealing Spectro DMG.
Ring of Mirrors
- Ring of Mirrors lasts for 30s. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.
- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a Basic Attack or Dodge Counter that hits the Ring of Mirrors will deal extra DMG and pull the targets hit to the center of the Ring of Mirrors.
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, dealing Spectro DMG.

info.name: Radiant Invocation
info.description:
When Phoebe's Prayer is full, consume all Prayer to cast one of the following skills:
- Hold Basic Attack to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany, dealing Spectro DMG and applying Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Absolution that focuses more on dealing direct DMG.
- Hold Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Utter Confession, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Confession that focuses more on Spectro Frazzle.
Heavy Attack: Starflash
When Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting Basic Attack 3 or Dodge Counter replaces the next Heavy Attack with Heavy Attack: Starflash, which deals Spectro DMG at the cost of 30 Divine Voice.
- Absolution Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by 15. When the targets hit have Spectro Frazzle, the skill deals more DMG.
- Confession Enhancement: Apply Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit.
Prayer
Phoebe can hold up to 120 Prayer.
Phoebe automatically gains 5 Prayer every second.
Divine Voice
Phoebe can hold up to 60 Divine Voice.
Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores Divine Voice.

info.name: Restless Watch
info.description:
Resonance Skill
Deal Spectro DMG. Zani can block attacks within a certain time after casting Resonance Skill. A successful block reduces DMG taken and triggers a counterattack.
Forte Gauge - Redundant Energy
- Perform Basic Attack, Resonance Skill, or Intro Skill to obtain Redundant Energy.
- When Redundant Energy is full, Enhanced Resonance Skill becomes available.
Enhanced Resonance Skill
- Hold Resonance Skill to charge up the attack, during which Zani is immune to interruption and blocks attacks. A successful block reduces DMG taken and triggers a counterattack. Release the button in advance or fully charge up to attack the target.
- Deal Spectro DMG (also considered Spectro Frazzle DMG), inflict Heliacal Ember upon the target, and Amplify the Spectro Frazzle DMG dealt by herself.

info.name: There Will Be A Light
info.description:
Forte Gauge - Blaze
- When a nearby Resonator in the team inflicts Spectro Frazzle upon a target, trigger the damage effect immediately and inflict Heliacal Ember upon the target. Meanwhile, Zani restores Blaze.
- Casting Resonance Liberation  or Enhanced Resonance Skill grants Blazes.
- When in the Enhanced State and Blaze is higher than the tick mark, Heavy Slashes become available.
Heliacal Ember
Increases Outro Skill DMG. Its stacks count towards the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.
Heavy Slash
- Press  Normal Attack or hold Resonance Skill to cast.
- Hold Resonance Skill to charge up, during which Zani is immune to interruptions and blocks attacks. A successful block reduces DMG taken and triggers a counterattack. Release the button in advance or fully charge up to attack the target directly.
- Deal Spectro DMG, considered both Heavy Attak DMG and Spectro Frazzle DMG.

info.name: Between Dawn and Dusk
info.description:
Resonance Liberation
Deal Spectro DMG and enter an Enhanced State, where the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack is increased and Heavy Slashes and Finisher Resonance Liberation are unlocked.
Finisher Resonance Liberation
Available when Forte Gauge Blaze is lower than the tick mark or after a certain time in the Enhanced State. Deal high Spectro DMG and end the Enhanced State.

info.description: Deal Spectro DMG.

Rending Lunge

Death Snip
Deal Havoc DMG and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Press or hold Normal Attack during this skill to deal additional Havoc DMG.

info.name: Fractured Composition

Resonance Skill
Deal Havoc DMG and mark the targets.
Enhanced Resonance Skill
When Forte Gauge is full, Enhanced Resonance Skill becomes available.

Casting this skill sends Chisa into Chainsaw Mode.
Mark

info.name: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion
info.description:
Forte Gauge

Chisa consumes Forte Gauge to cast Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack. The more Forte Gauge consumed, the higher DMG the next Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack deals.
Thread of Bane
Ignore some of the marked targets' DEF when dealing damage.
Chainsaw Mode
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack and Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack become available.
Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack
Deal Havoc DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack
Deal a massive amount of Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Liberation DMG) and grant Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill ends Chainsaw Mode.

info.name: Moment of Nihility
info.description:
Resonance Liberation
Deal Havoc DMG and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Enhanced Chainsaw Mode.
Enhanced Chainsaw Mode
The DMG Multipliers of Chainsaw Mode Basic Attack and Chainsaw Mode Finisher Attack are significantly increased.

info.name: Reverberance - Return
info.description: Deal Havoc DMG.

info.name: Chroma Drift
info.description:
Charging State

Roller Skate Heavy Attack
While in Roller Skating Mode, hold Normal Attack on the ground to continuously cast Ground Heavy Attack and deliver a finisher blow upon release. Hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Heavy Attack.

info.name: Chromaticity Modeling

Roller Skating Mode
After the Charging State, Lynae enters Roller Skating Mode and unlocks new moves.
Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap
During Roller Skating Mode, press Jump and consume 1/3 of the max Lumiflow to perform a leap attack, dealing Spectro DMG. Inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit. Can be cast up to 3 consecutive times.
Roller Skate Plunge Chain Attack
During Roller Skating Mode, while in mid-air with max True Color, if Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack is not on cooldown, cast Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack, otherwise cast Roller Skate Plunge Attack instead. Inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
Casting Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack increases the Tune Break Boost for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Resonance Mode
Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on targets based on the current Resonance Mode.
Overflow
While in Default State, attacks recover Overflow.
Lumiflow
While in Roller Skating Mode, moving or attacking continuously restores Lumiflow.
True Color
While in combat, each Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap grants 1 point of True Color.

info.name: Prismatic Overblast
info.description:
Casting this skill increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team.
Motorbike Chain Attack
Press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Resonance Liberation to cast a chain attack using the motorbike.

info.name: Time to Show Some Colors!
info.description: Recover Overflow and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets.

Basic Attack

Mid-air Attack
Deal Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Deal Spectro DMG and inflict Tune Strain - Shifting. The skill has 2 charges.
Enhanced Resonance Skill

Aureate Judge
Certain skills restore Forte Gauge. When Forte Gauge is full, the DMG Multipliers increase for all Enhanced Resonance Skills.
Golden Rule
When other Resonators in the team cast Outro Skill and Luuk Herssen is the incoming Resonator, he additionally restores Forte Gauge and Concerto Energy. This effect has a cooldown of 24s.
Dawnlit Keep
Luuk Herssen gains 1 stack of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over 4s or casts Intro Skill, which reduces DMG taken and grants immunity to interruptions for a time.
Radiant Reave
Hurl out a whirling blade to attack when Dodging in mid-air, dealing fixed Spectro DMG.

info.name: Rewritten in Winter's Margins
info.description: Deal Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

info.name: Before Injection of Dawn

Deal Spectro DMG.
Heavy Attack

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding

Heavy Attack - Single Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading, dealing increased Spectro DMG.
Heavy Attack - Dual Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction and at full Root Access, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading, dealing increased Spectro DMG. Hold or press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
Heavy Attack - Multi-threading

info.description:
Resonance Skill - Payload
Deal Spectro DMG. Hitting a target triggers Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. Reduce the skill CD by a certain proportion when no target is hit.
Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference
